title: Hayati Pro Max Menthol Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Menthol offers a clean, cooling vape with a crisp and brisk flavour profile. It delivers a pure Menthol sensation from start to finish, perfect for vapers who prefer a simple yet effective blast of icy freshness. Straightforward and satisfying, it’s ideal as a standalone vape or for mixing with other flavours. Blended with nicotine salts for fast absorption and a more comfortable throat hit, this e-liquid performs best in MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and vape pens. The 50VG/50PG ratio ensures steady flavour and discreet vapour output. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
